svg.title: Forest closure OPEN - same alphabet, scaled widths
svg.desc: Shared-alphabet alternative: all large lettering uses the same 19-glyph reconstructed master set, with independent width/height scaling and measured placement. OPEN and CLOSED share a 1000 by 130 panel convention. The subset is an original reconstruction, not an identified historical font. The small oval remains interpretive outlined artwork. No raster images or autotracing are used.
